head: STAND OUT AT
YOUR NEXT
<g>CAREERS</g> FAIR
hacks: Trying to talk to everyone leaves you exhausted and unmemorable.
Research the exhibitor list and choose your top three before going.
Recruiters hear dozens of vague pitches every hour.
Say: "I am a final year in maths, looking at your graduate scheme."
Asking basic information makes you sound unprepared.
Ask: "What do you enjoy most about working in this team?"
Standard company flyers rarely help you make personal contact.
Ask: "May I connect with you on LinkedIn to follow up later?"
Recruiters forget conversations quickly after busy events.
Send a LinkedIn note mentioning one specific point from your chat.
out: Send it to a uni classmate
